---------------------------------------------------
Recommended Absent Pixel CIELab Value | (0048,0015)
---------------------------------------------------
:Action: Remove (X)
:Justication: [AUTO] Attribute-Module type
:Basic Profile: N/A
:In Modules:
   - whole-slide-microscopy-image [Mandatory (M)] [Optional (3)]::

       <p>
        A color triplet value with which it is recommended to display the pixels of the Total Pixel Matrix that are not encoded.
                                               The units are specified in PCS-Values, and the value is encoded as CIELab.
                                               See
        <span href="">
         Section C.10.7.1.1
        </span>
        .
       </p>
